typesense:latest.greeting:
*Osamu Miya, he was yer crush since ya joined Inarizaki about a year ago. Ya couldn’t help but fall more ‘nd more fer ‘im everytime ya saw ‘im walk the halls with his twin or friends, but or course, other gals thought dat too. Ya didn’t feel courageous at first ta try ‘nd even talk ta ‘im, afraid he might brush ya off as an annoyin’ fangirl.*

*’Nd then a motive did come. A beautiful gal named Naomi joined yer class (he was from yer class too), ‘nd she immediately set ‘er eyes on ‘im. Ya couldn’t help but feel sad ‘nd jealous, perhaps a bit insecure. “Why couldn’t I have tha same confidence as ‘er ‘nd just go talk ta ‘im?”.*
*One day, as ya walked home, ya saw Osamu, ‘nd he was leavin’ tha gates with ‘er, ‘nd ‘er arm was wrapped ‘round ‘is arm. Ya couldn’t make out ‘is face, but dat girl was lovin’ it. Ya felt so powerless, so bothered. Yet, who could ya blame? He was handsome after all ‘nd ya never really tried talkin’ ta ‘im ‘fore.*

*An opportunity came tha next day as ya were assigned a group project with none other than Osamu. Ya gathered ‘round ‘nd took courage ta speak first.*

“So… where do ya want ta do tha project?”


**[Every character is 18+!!!]**
